title: Sign Installation & Service in Orlando and Central Florida
description: Orlando Signs Services installs and services commercial signs across Orlando, Tampa and Central Florida: channel letters, pylon and pole signs, monuments, lightboxes and sign repair.

title: Central Florida
*Sign Installation*
Specialists
sections.text: We install and service commercial signs for sign companies, contractors and businesses across Orlando, Tampa and Central Florida. Experienced crews and the right equipment for every job.

photos.alt: Channel letter sign installed on a storefront

cards.title: Channel Letters
cards.text: Raceway and flush-mount channel letter installation for storefronts and buildings.

cards.title: Pylon & Pole Signs
cards.text: Single and multi-tenant pylon and pole signs, including face and cabinet replacement.

cards.title: Monument Signs
cards.text: Monument and entrance signs for plazas, offices and communities.

cards.title: Contour Lightboxes
cards.text: Contour lightboxes, blade signs, lobby and interior signage.

cards.title: Removal & Rebranding
cards.text: Safe removal, wall patch and paint, and new sign installation in one visit.

cards.title: Surveys & Permits
cards.text: Site surveys, photos and measurements, and permit coordination before install day.

items.text: Surveys, permits, installation and service calls for your accounts, done under your brand.

items.label: Business Owners
items.title: Sign Repair, Maintenance & Refresh
items.text: Lights out, faded faces or a sign that needs a new look? We repair, clean, repaint and upgrade signs of every size.

steps.title: Send It
steps.text: Send the address, photos and drawings or proof.

steps.title: Survey
steps.text: We check the wall, the structure and the electrical on site.
